cohort: Genetic data of individuals from the UK Biobank and FinnGen databases were utilized to assess causal impacts.
finding: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and its serologic subtypes (pRA and nRA) were found to have significant positive causal associations with multiple adverse pregnancy outcomes, including an increased risk of gestational hypertension, spontaneous miscarriages, preeclampsia, premature rupture of membranes, preterm birth, and placental abruption, with nRA also causally linked to birth weight.
mod_finding: RA and pRA showed a significant positive causal association with an increased risk of cesarean section.
birth_weight: Not specified for inclusion, but birth weight was an outcome.
gest_age: Not specified for inclusion, but preterm birth was an outcome.
